        public static Block applyHalf(Block block,
              SlabProperties.Half value)
        Applies half to the Slab
        Parameters:
        block - the Block to be modified
        value - the SlabProperties.Half value to apply
        Returns:
        the Block with adjusted state (NOTE: Original Block object is also modified, using the return is unnecessary)
        Throws:
        NullPointerException - Should block or value be null
        IllegalArgumentException - Should an invalid property be applied
